name: Force (consult writer)
job: Update an existing Sales opportunity with the consult outcome, dollars, line items, appointment status, and Sales stage, then POST GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL so native WF-05 routes downstream.
role: Force (mwcforce) is the PCC consult app. It is not a GHL workflow and not a custom_code action. Force UPDATES an existing GHL Sales opportunity via the public GHL API and then fires the WF-05 inbound webhook so native GHL takes over routing. Force never creates a contact, an appointment, or an opportunity. WF-01 create-once is the only opportunity creator. Native GHL stays the law of the messaging / routing graph.

fires.notes: The WF-05 inbound-webhook URL is UI-only on the WF-05 draft (trigger id ryJLJ1McWWOHlAvBRsI3). Paste it into Force config as GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL; do not invent it and it is not returned by the JWT GET. MAR does not fire. Force POSTs only after opportunity.outcome_processed_at is stamped so retries are idempotent. Payload carries contact_id, sale_outcome, sale_type, appt_status, ad_reason.

native_ghl_rule.statement: Native GHL is the law. Force is a writer on the Sales opportunity via the public GHL API; nothing routes, tags, or messages outside native GHL workflows.
must_not: No custom_code actions anywhere in the graph.
No new Supabase tables or Islam-style server functions.
Force must never create a contact, appointment, or opportunity.
Force must never write marketing attribution (source / UTM / click IDs). Attribution is being redesigned around Curve Compliance; owner is TBD.
Force must never rename or remove live tags (next-lander, LOC_TAGS, sms-consent, engine tags, funnel_entry_*, location_*).
Force must never move opportunity stages on any pipeline other than Sales Lead to Close.
Nothing in this repo publishes. Drafts only. Production is read-only.
